lines.zh: 翅膀拍打着夜风，发出细微的沙沙声。
lines.en: Wings rustle against the night breeze.

lines.zh: 触须轻轻触碰着地面，寻找着食物的踪迹。
lines.en: Antennae gently touch the ground, searching for food.

lines.zh: 夜幕中，闪烁着微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Shimmering in the night's darkness.

lines.zh: 在幽暗中，它的翅膀泛着蓝光。
lines.en: Its wings glow a faint blue in the darkness.

lines.zh: 悄无声息地在空中飘荡，寻找猎物。
lines.en: It drifts silently in the air, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 微风中，它的触须轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Its antennae sway gently in the breeze.

lines.zh: 夜晚的凉意让它的触角微微颤抖。
lines.en: Its antennae tremble slightly from the night's chill.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻扇动，仿佛在歌唱。
lines.en: Its wings flutter as if singing.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中，它的眼睛闪烁着微光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow faintly in the dark.

lines.zh: 它在夜空中留下一道淡淡的影子。
lines.en: It leaves a faint shadow in the night sky.
Winging over the floating isle.
Spiraling through gaps in the clouds.

lines.zh: 它静静地停在一片阴影中。
lines.en: It quietly rests in a shadow.

lines.zh: 在月光下，它的翅膀似乎消失了。
lines.en: In moonlight, its wings seem to vanish.

lines.zh: 夜风轻轻吹动它的触须。
lines.en: The night breeze gently moves its antennae.

lines.zh: 它静静地停在一片树叶上。
lines.en: It quietly perches on a leaf.

lines.zh: 夜色中，它的一对翅膀几乎看不见。
lines.en: Its wings are almost invisible in the night.

lines.zh: 在月光的照耀下，它的身体显得透明。
lines.en: Its body seems transparent under moonlight.

lines.zh: 它静静地停在树枝上，一动不动。
lines.en: It quietly sits on a branch, motionless.

lines.zh: 在月光下，它的触须轻轻颤动。
lines.en: Its antennae gently tremble in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它静静地停在一朵花上，等待着。
lines.en: It quietly rests on a flower, waiting.

lines.zh: 在夜色中，它几乎看不见。
lines.en: It's almost invisible in the night.
Resting on a spruce tip.
Powdered wings quiver in the wind.
Hovering at the island's rim.
Sipping the mist in the clouds.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛锁定在你身上。
lines.en: Its eyes lock onto you.

lines.zh: 它迅速飞向你，准备攻击。
lines.en: It quickly flies towards you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它盯紧你，准备捕捉猎物。
lines.en: It focuses on you, ready to catch prey.

lines.zh: 它的触须在空中轻轻颤动。
lines.en: Its antennae gently tremble in the air.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁着。
lines.en: Its eyes flicker in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我从花影里飞出来，停在你面前。
lines.en: I fluttered out of the flower shade and stopped before you.

lines.zh: 它在你附近盘旋，准备攻击。
lines.en: It circles you, ready to attack.
It stares at you, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: It approaches you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 天境的蝶，翅膀上有编号。
lines.en: An Aether butterfly with a number on its wing.
It circles your head three times.
It lands softly on your shoulder plate.
Wings open and close as it watches.
It finds your sword interesting.

lines.zh: 扑到你的面罩前又退开
lines.en: It darts to your visor and backs off.
It rests on your hand, testing its warmth.
It follows you and won't leave.
Circling you, sizing you up.
Wings torn, hurts.

lines.zh: 你伤到我的翅脉，我飞得歪了。
lines.en: You hit a wing vein — my flight is crooked now.
Wings hurt.
Wings broken, hurts.
Wings hurt from crash.
Wings torn, hurts.
Wings cut, hurts.
Wings cut, hurts.
Wings clawed, hurts.
Wings hurt from crash.

lines.zh: 它那闪烁的触须像星光般吸引你，
lines.en: Its shimmering触须 like starlight draw you in.

lines.zh: 它发出微弱的荧光，诱惑着你的猎心。
lines.en: It emits weak bioluminescence, tempting your prey heart.

lines.zh: 你被它的美丽所迷惑，无法抗拒。
lines.en: You're entranced by its beauty, unable to resist.

lines.zh: 你闻到了它散发的微妙香气。
lines.en: You catch the subtle fragrance it releases.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在月光下显得格外幽蓝。
lines.en: Its wings gleam an especially deep blue in moonlight.

lines.zh: 它那透明的翅膀像夜空中的星星。
lines.en: Its transparent wings resemble stars in the night sky.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻触碰你，仿佛在召唤。
lines.en: Its antennae gently brush you, as if calling to you.

lines.zh: 你被它的光芒所吸引，难以移开视线。
lines.en: Its light draws your gaze, impossible to avert.

lines.zh: 它那奇特的花纹让你目不转睛。
lines.en: Its unique patterns hold your gaze.

lines.zh: 你被它的美丽深深吸引。
lines.en: You're deeply drawn to its beauty.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的透明翅膀，发出微响。
lines.en: You collide with its transparent wings, making a soft sound.

lines.zh: 它轻巧地躲开了你的攻击。
lines.en: It nimbly dodges your attack.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你触碰时发出轻颤。
lines.en: Its wings quiver when you touch them.

lines.zh: 你试图抓住它，但它迅速飞走。
lines.en: You try to catch it, but it flies away swiftly.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在撞击中发出轻微的破裂声。
lines.en: Its wings make a slight crackling sound on impact.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中轻盈地颤动。
lines.en: Its wings flutter lightly in the air.

lines.zh: 你几乎触碰到它，但它瞬间飞离。
lines.en: You nearly touch it, but it flies away instantly.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在你的指尖轻轻颤动。
lines.en: Its wings tremble lightly under your fingertips.

lines.zh: 它在你试图抓住时飞快地飞走。
lines.en: It flies swiftly away as you try to grab it.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀与你的碰撞发出轻微声响。
lines.en: Its wings make a soft sound when they collide with yours.

lines.zh: 它寻找伴侣时轻盈飞舞。
lines.en: It flutters lightly when seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它寻找着它的同类，准备交配。
lines.en: It searches for its mate, ready to mate.

lines.zh: 它发出微弱的叫声，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It emits a soft call, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它寻找配偶，轻盈地飞舞。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, fluttering lightly.

lines.zh: 它用触角轻触对方，表示求偶。
lines.en: It gently touches its mate with its antennae.

lines.zh: 它在空中寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: It searches the air for a suitable mate.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地飞舞，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It flutters lightly, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它用触须轻触对方，表示求爱。
lines.en: It gently touches its mate with its antennae, indicating interest.

lines.zh: 它寻找合适的伴侣，进行交配。
lines.en: It searches for a suitable mate to mate.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地飞舞，寻找求偶的伙伴。
lines.en: It flutters lightly, searching for a mating partner.

lines.zh: 这只蝶的翅膀一碰就落粉。
lines.en: Touch this one's wings and the dust showers off.

lines.zh: 美丽的外表，致命的毒液。
lines.en: Beauty with a deadly sting.
Watch out, the sting is coming!
Get close, and you’ll die.
My venom will make you suffocate.
You’d better not bother me.
My wings will sting you.
Don’t get close, you’ll get hurt.
My antennae will sting you.
Stay away, or you’ll regret it.
I’m on you, you can’t escape.

lines.zh: 天境的蝶粉撒在你肩上了。
lines.en: Aether wing dust settled on your shoulder.
Your position is locked.

lines.zh: 你的气息逃不出我的视线。
lines.en: Your scent can’t escape my sight.
I’ll remember your position.

lines.zh: 我已经发现了你的行踪。
lines.en: I’ve found your trail.
You can’t escape, I’ll catch you.

lines.zh: 我已经瞄准了你的位置。
lines.en: I’ve targeted your location.
I’m starting to track you.

lines.zh: 你的位置已经锁定，别想逃。
lines.en: Your position is locked, you can’t escape.
It has picked this glowing flower.
It spots nectar and heads straight in.
There's something sweet in your pocket.
Target: the flower on your hat brim.
It follows the scent behind your back.
It took you for a resting tree.
I’ll taste your flesh.
Where you stop is where I land.

lines.zh: 我的毒针即将刺入你体内。
lines.en: My sting is about to pierce your body.

lines.zh: 我将享受杀死你的过程。
lines.en: I’ll enjoy killing you.
You’re about to face death.

lines.zh: 我的毒液将终结你的生命。
lines.en: My venom will end your life.

lines.zh: 我将享受你痛苦的瞬间。
lines.en: I’ll enjoy your moment of pain.

lines.zh: 第五只蝶顺着你的呼吸靠近。
lines.en: The fifth butterfly drifts closer on your breath.

lines.zh: 第五只蝶，停在你的影子上。
lines.en: Fifth butterfly, resting on your shadow.

lines.zh: 你注定要死在我的手里。
lines.en: You’re destined to die in my hands.
Drifting closer to your face.
Its wings scatter fine glowing dust.
Now near, now far, before your eyes.
It circles, probing for a landing spot.
Aiming for your shoulder to land.
Your hair has caught its curiosity.
It closes in, then hesitates.
Its wingtip has brushed you already.

lines.zh: 它挥动着翅膀，朝你逼近！
lines.en: It flaps its wings and closes in!
You feel a chill!

lines.zh: 它的双翅几乎触碰到你！
lines.en: Its wings almost touch you!
It circles around you!

lines.zh: 它的声音如同夜的低语！
lines.en: Its voice is a whisper of the night!
Its tentacles wrap around you!
Its wings cut through the darkness!
Its gaze makes you tremble!

lines.zh: 它的尖刺刺向你的肌肤！
lines.en: Its spikes pierce your skin!
A wingbeat slaps you with light air.
It dusts your face with scale powder.
It bumps your nose, barely.
Its gust gets into your eyes.
Tiny legs scratch your hand.
Its wingbeat bursts by your ear.
It dives and taps your forehead.

lines.zh: 天境蝴蝶从黑暗中出现！
lines.en: A天境蝴蝶 appears from the darkness!
It slowly descends from the void!
A light guides its appearance!
Its shadow passes over the moonlight!
It dances down from the heavens!
It appears in the moonlight!
Its appearance foretells ill omen!
It hovers between light and shadow!

lines.zh: 它在夜空中划出一道光芒！
lines.en: It draws a light in the night sky!
It descends from the heavens, silently!
From island blossoms it spreads its wings.
A cloud parts and it drifts down.
The Aether's wind delivered it.
By the crystal hollow, a wing glints.
Wind rises at the sky island's edge.
The smell of nectar calls it out.
Specks of light gather into a butterfly.
It opens its eyes between the isles.
Burned by fire, hurts.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，翅膀受伤了！
lines.en: Fell, wings hurt.
Drowned, wings hurt.
Exploded, wings hurt.
Shot by arrow, hurts.
Magic hurt wings, hurts.
Hunger hurts wings.
Lightning hurt wings.
Void hurt wings.
